title: Physical Audio Signal Processing (Julius O. Smith)
summary: Authoritative reference for physical modeling and signal processing in audio.
description:
## Overview

Julius O. Smith's work is the definitive reference for physical modeling synthesis, delay lines, and waveguide filters.

## Key Topics

| Topic | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Delay Lines | Circular buffers, interpolation |
| Waveguides | Physical modeling of instruments |
| Digital Waveguide Theory | String, tube, and acoustic modeling |
| Reverberation | Physical reverb modeling |

## Relevant For

- Delay line implementation
- Physical modeling synthesis
- Waveguide filters
- Interpolation algorithms

## Availability

Free online at: https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/pasp/

## Citation

Smith, Julius O. *Physical Audio Signal Processing*. Center for Computer Research in Music and Acoustics (CCRMA), Stanford University.

## Why Important

Foundational theory for delay-based effects and physical modeling with rigorous mathematical treatment.
